Thousands Deployed to Guard Rath Yatra in Ahmedabad

A massive crowd gathered for the Rath Yatra festival in Puri, Odisha, resulting in one death and over 100 injuries. The event was heavily guarded by police and drones. Authorities have expressed concerns about the safety of pilgrims, while some have criticized the government's handling of the situation.
